alu.flag.zero: Zero flag (Z): set when the ALU result is exactly 0 (evaluated on the signed result). The BZERO instruction branches when this flag is set.
alu.flag.negative: Negative flag (N): set when bit 15 (the most significant bit) of the result is 1 — a negative number in two's complement. The BNEG instruction branches when this flag is set.
alu.flag.unsignedOverflow: Unsigned overflow (UOV): set when the result does not fit in 16 unsigned bits — outside the range 0…65535.
alu.flag.signedOverflow: Signed overflow (SOV): set when the result does not fit in 16 signed two's-complement bits — outside the range −32768…32767.
alu.flag.stateNone: No ALU operation has run yet — flags have not been computed.
